name: Isaiah
summary: A prophet, the son of Amoz, who saw visions about Judah and Jerusalem during the reigns of four kings, from Uzziah to Hezekiah. He brought the LORD's word to kings in times of war and sickness.

key_moments.title: Sees the Lord on His Throne
key_moments.description: In the year King Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord on a high throne, with seraphims calling Him holy. A live coal touched his lips to take away his sin, and when the Lord asked who would go, Isaiah offered himself.

key_moments.title: Gives Ahaz the Sign of Immanuel
key_moments.description: When Syria and Israel threatened Judah, the LORD sent Isaiah to meet King Ahaz and tell him not to fear their plans. Isaiah then gave the sign of a virgin who would bear a son named Immanuel.

key_moments.title: Walks Barefoot for Three Years as a Sign
key_moments.description: The LORD told Isaiah to take off his sackcloth and shoes. He went about naked and barefoot for three years, as a sign of how Assyria would lead away the people of Egypt and Ethiopia.

key_moments.title: Tells Hezekiah Not to Fear Assyria
key_moments.description: When Assyria mocked the LORD, King Hezekiah's servants came to Isaiah. He told them the LORD said not to fear, for the king of Assyria would hear a rumor and go home.

key_moments.title: Promises Hezekiah Fifteen More Years
key_moments.description: Isaiah told the dying Hezekiah to set his house in order, but after the king prayed, the LORD sent Isaiah back to promise fifteen more years. As a sign, the shadow on the dial of Ahaz went back ten steps.
